svg.title: Open source Love!
svg.desc: Seven open-source projects by Kamal007OLica drawn as transit lines leaving one trunk: Design contributions, Uki AI, ZenMode OS, Night link cleaner, Obspec, Taste MCP and Mozhi, over 1,007 contributions since February 2024.

g.text: Seven lines, all public. Each tick is a commit
or an issue, each logo a project I filed into.
A little train rides every line, one at a time.

g.title: Penpot: 6 issues and a pull request

g.text: the trunk every line leaves from
